text: Debugging is an essential skill for any programmer, and it becomes much easier when you have a clear strategy. The first step is identifying the bug—this means figuring out the exact input that causes the error. Rather than guessing, use debugging tools like breakpoints in your code editor. These let you pause the program at specific lines to inspect variable values. A systematic approach is key: change one thing at a time and test frequently. Finally, make good use of logging. By adding print statements or log entries to key parts of your code, you can track the flow of data and see where things go wrong, making the solution far easier to find.
